title: Page 9
lines: 西南王妃才是世上最美的女人，没有之一。
而在这片土地上生活的百姓，没有一人不知静王有多爱他的王妃，爱得不愿多看其他女人，爱得愿意去死，只要王妃在的地方，他的目光只会专注在她身上。
同时王妃也是传奇，真正的女神，不畏一次又一次的失败，她成功地在最不利种植，长年多风少雨的西南种出颗粒饱满的水稻，让万千百姓从此不用再受挨饿之苦。
“啊！姊……我……我没干什么……只是……呵呵……帮帮……锻炼筋骨……”已长成高大青年的赵永真红着脸傻笑，摸着红透的耳根将他腰高的小人儿往身后一推，相护之意十分明显。
“没干什么你在心虚什么？天生不是说谎的料，一说谎就结巴，你这辈子只能当正直的清官，干不了逢迎拍马的佞臣。”这性子是怎会变成这样的，小时候明明顽皮得叫人头疼。
“姊，我干么当佞臣，姊夫都是一方藩王了，他来讨好我都来不及，我何必去拍他马屁，谁不知道西南的静王爷最看重的是我温柔美丽的大姊……啊！大姊，你轻点，别拧我耳朵，疼……我都不小了……”大姊性情越来越粗暴了。
“哼！你也晓得自己不小了，脑袋瓜里没包稻草。你嘴上说着温柔大方，心里肯定在腹诽道：‘这是哪来的野婆子，既泼辣又凶恶，谁家儿郎倒霉娶了她。’”遇到这些食古不化的古人，她不剽焊都不成。
看着一脸孩子气，实则已经能顶天立地的弟弟，赵若瑾心里有着骄傲，他刚来西南的第一年曾生了一场大病，差点救不回来，愈后身体孱弱，调养了两年才缓了过来。
如果他死在西南，她一辈子也无法原谅自己，是她要他来的，助她征服西南这片几乎不能居住的土地。
“冤枉呀！大姊，你给我九颗胆子我也不敢非议你一句，弟弟我非常爱护这条得之不易的小命，你别害我呀！姊夫会先宰了我。”静王爷爱妻出了名，宠到没边了。
可怜的姊夫，长期生活在姊姊的淫威之下。
“呿！少作戏，你一个大男人……上官青阳、上官青旭，你们想去哪里？丢下掩护你们的舅舅太没义气了。”当她没瞧见弟弟偷偷摸摸的打了手势吗？要两个小家伙先走。
一个虎头虎脑的小男童呐呐地从赵永真身后探出个小脑袋，神情蔫蔫地，另一个笑得很谄媚的小男童则从三人抱的大树后跑出来，嘻嘻哈哈的像做了一件很伟大的事。
焦不离孟，孟不离焦，有其一就有其二，两个玩得很野、都快成小野人的男孩，皮肤却白晰得好似刚由牛奶浴中捞起来，美得精致又白嫩，宛若年画娃娃。
软软地一喊，赵若瑾心里柔软得快化掉，恨不得将他们抱起来吻一遍，可是面上仍板着一张脸在教子。
上官青阳、上官青旭今年七岁了，和她跟赵若瑜一样是一对孪生子，两人长得一模一样，她生儿子时差点血崩，把上官静吓得死过一回，再也不让她生第二胎。
他怕失去她，很怕很怕，宁可不要孩子也要妻子活着，她才是他一生的依恋，没有她他活不下去。
“孩子顽皮点好生养，爬个树而已，哪个孩子没做过，瞧你把他们吓得，好在祖父不在，要不然劈头一顿臭骂。”柔似春风的声音轻轻扬起，让人有种在夏日喝了一杯凉水的清爽，暑气全消。
“大舅舅——”炮弹似的身影随着欢呼声朝来人奔去，连绷着神经的赵永真也松了一口气。
那一年静王夫妇离开京城不久，皇子们的皇位之争曾消停了一下，但随即爆发更大的冲突，大皇子死了，死于高热不退，长久以来的争夺战因此产生变化。
一直保持中立立场的兴武侯在三年后带着三十万赵家军到西北一带做军事演习，藉操兵为由扫荡了西北大大小小的匪窟贼窝，斩杀上万人，再一路追赶偷袭边关小城的西夷蛮人，追呀追到西南的占古城，然后就不走了。
同年，静王妃传出有孕的喜讯，徐氏高兴的收拾行李，带了一行人到西南探望女儿、女婿，同行的有赵老侯爷和赵府小儿子，一行人搬家似的凑了二十几辆大车，将府中贵重物品全搬上车。
然后，也不走了，一府老小定居在西南。
大楚因皇子之争越来越乱，到处狼烟四起，这里争那里夺的，派系林立的情形也越来越严重。
闹到最后，居然连军饷也发不出来，因为皇子们往各部大捞银子好充实自己实力，置百姓疾苦于不顾。
到了第五年，赵家军已完全归入西南静王麾下，他们的粮食和军饷是王妃发的，王妃凭一人之力养活一支军队。
“大哥，你几时回来的，军营不用练兵吗？”两个小兔崽子，一会儿娘再跟你们算帐。
靠山来了，两个小子也不怕娘亲的恶脸，古灵精怪的一人一边拉着大舅舅的手，朝娘亲扮鬼脸。
“有爹在，不用担心，北边的狼族又蠢蠢欲动了，下个月我打算带三万兵马过去瞧瞧。”先震威，打两场，再打不怕就灭了，大楚一乱，这些边陲小国就不安分了。
赵永湛九年前娶了定国公府嫡女巫素灵，巫素灵娘家那一房和定国公也来到西南定居，避开朝中纷乱。
不过生了三个儿子的巫素灵特别眼热“别人家”的女儿。
“你小心点，凡事多留点心眼，穷寇莫追，多带几颗雷火弹防身。”不怕一万，只怕万一。
雷火弹就是改良版的小型炸弹，捂着藏着多年的赵若瑾终于取出火药配方尝试制作，花了半年才研制成功。
其实她一开始的用意不是用在战场杀戮上，而是想炸平满是瘴气的沼泽，她一里一里的推进，把原本不适合耕种的土地变成良田，再教百姓怎么种植，从最简单的大豆开始。
长年淤积的沼泽地相当肥沃，短期作物一种下几乎没有意外的大丰收，在连种了两年大豆后，土质也改变了，因此赵若瑾决定试种她带来的嫁妆种子——水稻。
第一年收成差强人意，水量不够，所以她灵机一动将原来满是黑水的沼泽引入活水，再植上水莲、荷花之类能净化水质的植物，使其变成能饮用、蓄水的湖泊，供人取用。
果然，到了第二年稻作产量增加一倍有余，百姓们也投入水稻的种植中，大片的沼泽地成了能耕种的良田，百姓有粮食吃了。
以此类推，将稻米推广到西南每一块土地上，短短数年内，原本最贫瘠的西南一地成了大楚最富饶的粮仓，处处可见低得弯腰的饱实稻穗，铺上青石板的官道两旁种的是结实累累的果树，果大肉饱满，路过的人都能摘食，解一时之渴。
但最欣欣向荣的却不是一望无际的稻田，而是配合西南气候的药圃、香料园，沿着潮湿、向阳的低洼地区种植，也有些是丛林里移植出来的罕见药材，一园一园的成为药材、香料集中地，现采现制现卖，供远道而来的商贩购买。
玉石也是赚钱行业，光是几颗雕琢成型的玉石成品就能养活一支军队，可见获利之丰。
彻底发挥金手指的赵若瑾本事还不只如此，她成立全西南毛皮收购中心，不是整车整车地运往大楚各地贩售，而是处理过做成皮衣、皮帽、皮靴、皮手套、皮围脖……任何她想得到的皮制品。
content_en:
Princess Southwest is the most beautiful woman in the world, bar none.
And no one living in this land knows how much King Jing loves his princess. He loves her so much that he doesn't want to look at other women, and he loves her so much that he is willing to die. As long as the princess is there, his eyes will only focus on her.
At the same time, the princess is also a legend, a true goddess. She is not afraid of failure again and again. She successfully grows rice with full grains in the southwest, which is the most unfavorable place for planting, with wind and rain all year round, so that thousands of people no longer have to suffer from hunger.
"Ah! Sister...I...I didn't do anything...just...haha...help...exercise my muscles..." Zhao Yongzhen, who has grown into a tall young man, blushed and smiled stupidly. He touched the base of his red ears and pushed his waist-high little man behind him. His intention to protect each other was very obvious.
"You haven't done anything, why are you feeling guilty? You're not a liar by nature, and you stutter when you lie. You can only be an upright official in this life, and you can't be a flattering minister." How did this temperament become like this? When I was a child, I was so naughty that it gave me a headache.
"Sister, why should I be a sycophant? My brother-in-law is already a vassal king. It's too late for him to please me. Why should I flatter him? Who doesn't know that Prince Jing of the Southwest values ​​my gentle and beautiful eldest sister most... Ah! Sister, please be gentle and don't pinch my ears. It hurts... I'm not young anymore..." The eldest sister's temperament became more and more rude.
"Hmph! You also know that you are not young anymore, and there is no straw in your head. You talk about being gentle and generous, but you must be cursing in your heart: 'Where did this wild woman come from? She is both fierce and vicious. Whose son is unlucky to marry her.'" When she met these ancient people who did not change their past, she couldn't do it without plagiarism.
Looking at his younger brother who looked childish but was actually able to stand up to the world, Zhao Ruojin felt proud in his heart. In the first year after he came to Southwest China, he got seriously ill and almost couldn't be saved. He became weak after recovery and it took him two years to recover.
If he died in the southwest, she would never be able to forgive herself for the rest of her life. It was she who asked him to come to help her conquer the almost uninhabitable land in the southwest.
"It's unfair! Sister, even if you give me nine courages, I don't dare to criticize you. Brother, I cherish this hard-earned life very much. Don't harm me! My brother-in-law will kill me first." Prince Jing was famous for his love for his wife, and he loved her to no end.
The poor brother-in-law has lived under the power of his sister for a long time.
"Hey! Stop acting, you're a grown man... Shangguan Qingyang, Shangguan Qingxu, where do you want to go? It's so unloyal to abandon your uncle who is protecting you." Didn't she see her brother making a secret gesture? I want the two little guys to go first.
A little boy with a tiger-like head poked his head out from behind Zhao Yongzhen with a wilted expression. Another little boy with a flattering smile ran out from behind the big tree that the three of them were hugging, laughing and joking as if he had done something great.
Jiao Bu Li Meng, Meng Bu Li Jiao, if one is there, the other will be the same. The two boys are playing wildly and are almost like little savages, but their skin is as white as if they had just been fished out of a milk bath. They are as beautiful as delicate and white, like dolls in New Year paintings.
"Mother——"
With a soft cry, Zhao Ruojin felt so soft that she almost melted away. She wished she could pick them up and kiss them again, but she still had a straight face as she taught her son.
Shangguan Qingyang and Shangguan Qingxu are seven years old this year. They are twins like her and Zhao Ruoyu. They look exactly the same. She almost had a hemorrhage when she gave birth to her son, which frightened Shangguan Jing to death once and never allowed her to have a second child.
He was afraid of losing her, so afraid that he would rather not have children than to keep his wife alive. She was his lifelong attachment, and he couldn't live without her.
"Children should be naughty for good health. It's just a matter of climbing a tree. Which child has never done this before? Look how scared you are of them. Fortunately, grandpa is not here, otherwise he would have been scolded." A voice as soft as the spring breeze rose softly, making people feel as refreshing as drinking a glass of cold water in the summer, and the heat was gone.
"Uncle——" The cannonball-like figure ran towards the visitor with the cheers, and even the nervous Zhao Yongzhen breathed a sigh of relief.
Not long after Prince Jing and his wife left the capital that year, the battle for the throne among the princes subsided for a while, but then a greater conflict broke out. The eldest prince died of a persistent fever, and the long-standing battle for the throne changed.
Three years later, Marquis Xingwu, who had always maintained a neutral stance, took 300,000 Zhao troops to the northwest for military exercises. On the pretext of conducting military exercises, he raided the dens of bandits and thieves in the northwest, killing tens of thousands of people. He then chased the Xiyi barbarians who attacked the border town all the way to the ancient city of Zhan in the southwest, and then stopped leaving.
In the same year, the good news came out that Princess Jing was pregnant. Mrs. Xu happily packed her luggage and took a group of people to the southwest to visit her daughter and son-in-law. Along with them were Mr. Zhao and the youngest son of the Zhao family. The group gathered together more than 20 large cars as if moving, and loaded all the valuables in the house into the car.
Then, instead of leaving, the whole family settled in the southwest.
Dachu was becoming more and more chaotic due to the dispute between princes, and wars were everywhere. There were fights here and there, and the situation of factions became more and more serious.
In the end, even military pay could not be paid, because the princes went to various ministries to make money to enrich themselves, regardless of the suffering of the people.
By the fifth year, the Zhao family army was completely under the command of King Jing of the Southwest. Their food and military pay were provided by the princess, who supported an army with her own strength.
"Brother, when did you come back? Don't you need to train in the military camp?" You two little bastards, my mother will settle accounts with you later.
Now that they have a supporter, the two boys are not afraid of their mother's evil face. The quirky one holds his uncle's hand and makes faces at his mother.
"Dad is here, don't worry. The wolf tribe in the north is ready to move again. Next month I plan to bring 30,000 soldiers and horses to have a look." First, shock the enemy, fight two games, and then destroy them without fear. Once the big Chu is in chaos, these small border countries will become restless.
Zhao Yongzhan married Su Ling, the direct witch of Duke Ding's palace, nine years ago. Wu Suling's maiden family and Duke Ding also came to settle in the southwest to avoid the chaos in the court.
But Wu Suling, who had given birth to three sons, was particularly keen on the daughters of "other people".
"Be careful, be careful about everything, don't chase the poor, and bring a few more thunder and fire bombs to defend yourself." Don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of the unexpected.
The thunder bomb is an improved version of a small bomb. Zhao Ruojin, who had been hiding it for many years, finally took out the gunpowder formula and tried to make it. It took him half a year to successfully develop it.
In fact, her original intention was not to use it for battlefield killing, but to blow up the miasma-filled swamps. She pushed forward mile by mile, turning the land that was originally unsuitable for farming into fertile land, and then taught the people how to plant it, starting with the simplest soybeans.
The swamps that have been silted for many years are quite fertile, and there is almost no unexpected bumper harvest for short-term crops. After planting soybeans for two consecutive years, the soil quality has also changed, so Zhao Ruojin decided to try planting the dowry seeds she brought - rice.
The harvest in the first year was unsatisfactory and there was not enough water, so she came up with the idea to introduce living water into the swamp that was originally full of black water, and then planted water lilies, lotus and other plants that can purify the water, turning it into a lake that can drink and store water for people to use.
Sure enough, in the second year, the rice production more than doubled, and the people also invested in rice planting. Large swamps became good farmland for cultivation, and the people had food to eat.
By analogy, rice was promoted to every piece of land in the southwest. In just a few years, the southwest, which was originally the most barren land, became the most fertile granary in Dachu. You can see the bending-down and full ears of rice everywhere. The official roads paved with bluestones are planted with fruit trees on both sides. The fruits are large and plump, and anyone passing by can pick them to quench their thirst.
But the most prosperous thing is not the endless rice fields, but the medicinal gardens and spice gardens that match the southwest climate. They are planted along the humid and sunny low-lying areas. Some of them are rare medicinal materials transplanted from the jungle. One garden after another has become a concentration of medicinal materials and spices. They are picked, prepared and sold for traders from afar.
Jade is also a profitable industry. Just a few carved jade products can feed an army, which shows how profitable it is.
Zhao Ruojin, who has given full play to her golden fingers, is not only capable of this. She has established a southwest fur purchasing center. Instead of transporting entire trucks to Dachu for sale, she has processed them into leather jackets, leather hats, leather boots, leather gloves, leather scarves... any leather products she can think of.
